title: Rav Dovid Cohen Warns
body: Rav Dovid Cohen, Chevron rosh yeshiva, addressed hundreds of talmidim at a Chanukah mesibah, warning of an unprecedented threat to the Torah world. He described the decree as severe, with a goal to secularize all of Israel.

title: Rav Yosef Calls for Change
body: Rav Yitzchak Yosef, former Sephardic Chief Rabbi of Israel, called for a change in Sephardic yeshivos' Chanukah candle lighting customs, questioning the practice of interrupting seder learning for the mitzvah.
